sql:
/* 首周前四日玩法参与、主线推进及重试代理失败率；仅比较首四日创角用户。 */
WITH Config AS (SELECT DATE '2026-07-29' tc_start,DATE '2026-08-02' tc_end,DATE '2026-05-08' sg_start),
TCB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_18 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
SGB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
SGC AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_country' AND tag_value='新加坡'),
SGA AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_os' AND tag_value='Android'),
M AS (SELECT '新加坡全体(iOS+Android)' grp,c.u FROM SGC c UNION ALL SELECT '新加坡Android',c.u FROM SGC c JOIN SGA a ON c.u=a.u),
Cohort AS (
 SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,e."#account_id" aid FROM ta.v_event_18 e CROSS JOIN Config c LEFT JOIN TCB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_event"='new_role' AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.tc_start AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(c.tc_end AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL AND CAST(e."#account_id" AS VARCHAR) NOT IN ('4100002','91110','91111') GROUP BY 1,2
 UNION ALL SELECT m.grp,e."#account_id" FROM ta.v_event_13 e CROSS JOIN Config c JOIN M m ON e."#user_id"=m.u LEFT JOIN SGB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_event"='new_role' AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.sg_start AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(DATE_ADD('day',DATE_DIFF('day',c.tc_start,c.tc_end),c.sg_start) AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL GROUP BY 1,2
),
E AS (
 SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,e."#account_id" aid,e."#event_name" ev,TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER) stage_type,TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT) stage_id,e."#event_time" et FROM ta.v_event_18 e CROSS JOIN Config c LEFT JOIN TCB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.tc_start AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(c.tc_end AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL AND CAST(e."#account_id" AS VARCHAR) NOT IN ('4100002','91110','91111')
 UNION ALL SELECT m.grp,e."#account_id",e."#event_name",TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER),TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT),e."#event_time" FROM ta.v_event_13 e CROSS JOIN Config c JOIN M m ON e."#user_id"=m.u LEFT JOIN SGB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.sg_start AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(DATE_ADD('day',DATE_DIFF('day',c.tc_start,c.tc_end),c.sg_start) AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL
),
F AS (SELECT e.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY e.grp,e.aid,e.stage_id ORDER BY e.et) num,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY e.grp,e.aid,e.stage_id) total FROM E e JOIN Cohort c ON e.grp=c.grp AND e.aid=c.aid WHERE e.ev='stage_fight' AND e.stage_type=1001),
ModeAgg AS (SELECT e.grp,CASE WHEN e.ev='stage_fight' THEN CONCAT('副本_',CAST(e.stage_type AS VARCHAR)) WHEN e.ev='match3_combo' THEN '三消' WHEN e.ev='pet_travel_start' THEN '宠物旅行' WHEN e.ev='board_tile_land' THEN '大富翁' END mode,COUNT(*) times,COUNT(DISTINCT e.aid) users FROM E e JOIN Cohort c ON e.grp=c.grp AND e.aid=c.aid WHERE e.ev IN ('stage_fight','match3_combo','pet_travel_start','board_tile_land') GROUP BY 1,2),
StageAgg AS (SELECT grp,stage_id,COUNT(DISTINCT aid) users,COUNT(*) times,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN num=1 AND total>=2 THEN aid END) retry_users FROM F GROUP BY 1,2),
MaxStage AS (SELECT grp,aid,MAX(stage_id) max_stage_id FROM F GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT 'mode' "数据模块",m.grp "对比组",m.mode "对象",m.users "参与人数",m.times "参与次数",ROUND(100.0*m.users/NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Cohort c WHERE c.grp=m.grp),0),2) "参与率(%)",NULL "推断首次失败率(%)",NULL "最高关卡ID",NULL "最高关卡用户数" FROM ModeAgg m
UNION ALL SELECT 'stage_failure',grp,CAST(stage_id AS VARCHAR),users,times,NULL,ROUND(100.0*retry_users/NULLIF(users,0),2),stage_id,NULL FROM StageAgg
UNION ALL SELECT 'progression',grp,'最高主线关卡',NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,max_stage_id,COUNT(*) FROM MaxStage GROUP BY grp,max_stage_id
ORDER BY 1,2,8;
